stock.description: Steve Leung Design Group Limited is a prominent architectural and interior design firm that delivers its services across mainland China, Hong Kong, and various international locations. The company's operations are segmented into three core areas: Interior Design Services, Interior Decorating and Furnishing Services, and Product Design Services. It specializes in crafting interior environments, including decoration and furnishing, for a broad spectrum of properties. This encompasses residential projects like show flats, luxury private homes, and serviced apartments, alongside commercial and institutional developments such as sales offices, exclusive clubhouses, retail malls, corporate workspaces, aged care facilities, educational institutions, and medical centers. The firm also has extensive experience in the hospitality sector, designing for restaurants, bars, and hotels. Additionally, Steve Leung Design Group Limited is involved in the trade of interior decorative items and manages licensing agreements related to its product design offerings. The company was established in 1997, with its headquarters located in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong, and functions as a subsidiary of Eagle Vision Development Limited.
